summary: Choose End Rage to gain 15 temporary HP.

fields.Ever Vigilant: Manually ending Rage grants 15 temporary HP. The bonus disappears at the end of combat. Temporary HP does not stack.
fields.Acquisition: Locked chest behind the caravan survivors fighting gnolls on the Risen Road.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
